title: Village shared definitions
description: Leaf definitions shared by every Village contract. Referenced as common.schema.json#/$defs/<name>. Not an instance schema on its own.

contract_version.description: Bump in contracts/VERSION, every schema's x-contract-version, and here, together.

role_key.description: View key. Care villages: elder | coordinator | helper. Block villages: coordinator | resident | volunteer.

invite_id.description: Join invite minted at activation (one active per member with a view). 1.1.0.

invite_token.description: Secret join token (/join?i=<invite_token>). Same rules as slot_token: hashed at rest, never in specs, logs or traces; refer to it by invite_id. 1.1.0.

slot_token.description: Signed per-slot lid token (secret). Never stored in specs or traces; specs reference token_ref instead.

village_status.description: Village lifecycle (FS-3). draft = edits allowed via PATCH /villages/{id}/draft, no invites/calls/prompts (QR and activate-dependent routes answer 409); active = invites minted, edits only via proposals. 1.1.0.

datetime.description: RFC 3339 with explicit offset. Demo clock times are America/New_York (-04:00 in October).

localized.description: Text by language. At least one language; demo villages always carry es and en where shown to both.

say.description: Gate-owned verbatim lines. Empty string = say/show nothing.

props.description: Component props: primitives or arrays of primitives only (builder rule).

actor.description: Who caused a ledger row: a member, or a system actor.

ref.description: call: conversation_id · app: member_id or ws req_id · scan: token_ref (never the token) · url: short label · system: component name (scheduler, gate, evolve, release, seed).

secs.description: Offset in the call (system__call_duration_secs at tool time). Required when kind=call.

quote.description: Verbatim words when available (utterance or transcript span).

am.description: Observability + Agent Memory links for a row.

key.description: Agent Memory fact key or id written for this row (e.g. last_dose_taken).

rule_id.description: Gate rule ids (R-*) or builder policy ids (P-*). Known R-*: R-DOUBLE, R-DOSE-ADVICE, R-WINDOW, R-MISSED, R-911, R-CONSENT, R-AUTONOMY, R-RUMOR, R-PRIORITY, R-SPEC, R-KILL, R-MONEY-NEVER, R-MONEY-VERIFY, R-MONEY-DEFAULT, R-MONEY-UNKNOWN, R-MONEY-PATTERN, R-VERIFY-CONSENT, R-NOOP.

say_key.description: Template key of the verbatim line (policy_cases.md). Known: money_hold, money_denied, money_timeout, money_confirmed, money_unknown, money_never, money_share_disclosure, dd_report, dose_recorded, advise_911_first, no_dose_advice, schedule_readback, family_notified, core_down, money_core_down (1.1.0: fixed script when Core is unreachable during a money call; the agent speaks it and never improvises).

member_channel.description: Per-member channels assigned by the builder (D3, D13). app:<role_key> = the role view. 1.3.0 (D22): refill_day = this member owns the refill checklist (RefillCard) on refill day; check_in_call = optional evening check-in call to the care recipient (needs her consent; she can decline). lid_qr stays valid but is no longer assigned in the Reyes fixture (D22 retired lid stickers).

notify_channel.description: app = ledger row + card; app_banner = 'Village is calling you' banner over WS; outbound_call = ElevenLabs/Twilio call.

verification_answer.description: yes = it was me (confirm) · no = it wasn't me (deny) · unsure.

message_kind.description: D16 village chat. Members write only chat; Village posts incident (from an incident row), proposal (Approve / Not now inline), receipt (release), nudge (rota or dose status line), answer (reply to an @Village question). 1.1.0.

message_ref.description: What a chat message cites (source chips). id is the referenced object's id: ev_* / dc_* / prop_* / rel_* / inc_* / ver_* / m_*, an Agent Memory fact key, a trace id, or a rule id. 1.1.0.

label.description: Chip text, e.g. 'her call, 0:09', 'rule R-MONEY-VERIFY', 'consent record', 'receipt'.

action_name.description: Actions → POST /v/{id}/actions/{name} or WS action; always gated. BigButton may use the first 12; start_verification (ScamCheck), answer_verification (VerificationPrompt), ack_incident (IncidentCard) and approve_proposal/reject_proposal (Proposal) are built into their components.

view_patch_op.description: RFC 6902 op restricted to a role view (builder patch_app rules). Paths are relative to the view object.

json_patch_op.description: Unrestricted RFC 6902 op (used only for spec-level ops such as printables).
